name: What a Cartoon!
description: Various original cartoons by some of today's top animators.

videos.title: Boo Boo Runs Wild
videos.overview: A 1999 stand-alone special, and a parody of The Yogi Bear Show made by The Ren & Stimpy Show creator John K

videos.title: A Day In The Life Of Ranger Smith
videos.overview: A 1999 stand-alone special, and a parody of The Yogi Bear Show made by The Ren & Stimpy Show creator John K

videos.title: The Powerpuff Girls: Meat Fuzzy Lumpkins
videos.overview: The Powerpuff Girls fight to stop Fuzzy Lumpkins' plot to turn everything into meat.

videos.title: Dexter's Laboratory
videos.overview: Dee Dee and Dexter battle turning each other into animals, using Dexter's latest invention.

videos.title: Yuckie Duck: Short Orders
videos.overview: Yuckie Duck works as a cook and waiter in a dirty restaurant, and delivers unappealing orders to the demanding customers.

videos.title: Dino: Stay Out!
videos.overview: The Flintstones' pet, Dino, tries to keep the house cat outside for the night.

videos.title: Johnny Bravo
videos.overview: Johnny Bravo tries to score with a zookeeper girl by capturing a runaway gorilla. Note: First pilot to Johnny Bravo.

videos.title: Sledgehammer O'Possum: Out and About
videos.overview: A trouble-making possum named Sledgehammer frustrates a dog's plans to enjoy a quiet summer day out.

videos.title: George and Junior: Look Out Below
videos.overview: Classic duo George and Junior attempt to fix a lightbulb an angry pigeon keeps breaking.

videos.title: Hard Luck Duck
videos.overview: After venturing away from Harley Gators watch, Hard Luck Duck is a hungry fox's target to be cooked.

videos.title: Shake & Flick: Raw Deal in Rome
videos.overview: A flea named Flick has a personal agenda with a local performer, a poodle named Shake, in an anachronistic Rome setting where the two constantly try to one up each other.

videos.title: The Adventures of Captain Buzz Cheeply: A Clean Getaway
videos.overview: Captain Buzz Cheeply and his robot sidekick, Slide, must escape a planet full of "Blubnoids" who have abnormally sized foreheads but small-sized brains whilst trying to do their laundry.

videos.title: O. Ratz with Dave D. Fly: Rat in a Hot Tin Can
videos.overview: A rat named O. Ratz and his fly companion, Dave D. Fly, try to find a place to stay for the night during winter in the city.

videos.title: Pfish and Chip: Short Pfuse
videos.overview: Pfish (a shark) and Chip (a short-tempered lynx) attempt to stop the squeaky-laughing Mad Bomber while the Chief naps.

videos.title: The Fat Cats: Drip Dry Drips
videos.overview: Louie and Elmo set a laundry business, expecting to earn some cash. They get a request from the President, but accidentally destroy his suit.

videos.title: George and Junior: George and Junior's Christmas Spectacular
videos.overview: George and Junior are forced to deliver one of Santa's presents after they fail to mail in one of his letters.

videos.title: Yoink! of the Yukon
videos.overview: The mounted police has its uniforms stolen, so Yoink and Sergeant Farnsworth Farflung are sent to retrieve them.

videos.title: Yuckie Duck: I'm on My Way
videos.overview: Yuckie Duck works as a paramedic, but does more harm than good to his patients.

videos.title: Mina and the Count: Interlude with a Vampire
videos.overview: Vlad the Count is forced to play with Mina after a mix-up in the schedule with his victims.

videos.title: Cow and Chicken: No Smoking
videos.overview: The Devil (later known as the Red Guy) kidnaps Chicken, who must be saved from damnation of smoking by Super Cow (who is his sister, Cow).

videos.title: Boid 'n' Woim
videos.overview: A worm named Mr. Woim hitchhikes in the middle of the California desert alongside a bird named Mr. Boid. While driving there, Woim crashes Boid's car and they begin to hallucinate.

videos.title: Jof: Help?
videos.overview: A cat that pricks his finger while sewing asks for help at the hospital, but its personnel do more harm than good.

videos.title: Podunk Possum: One Step Beyond
videos.overview: A possum acquires an abandoned farm with three chickens to lay eggs for him, and has to defend them from a fried chicken titan, Major Portions.

videos.title: The Powerpuff Girls: Crime 101
videos.overview: The Powerpuff Girls aid the bumbling Amoeba Boys in becoming able criminals.

videos.title: Wind-Up Wolf
videos.overview: The Big Bad Wolf creates a robot minion wolf to attempt to finally get the Three Little Pigs.

videos.title: Hillbilly Blue
videos.overview: Crawdad Eustace is fed-up with being treated as food and goes with possum pal Mordechai on a cross-country trip to New Orleans.

videos.title: Courage the Cowardly Dog: The Chicken from Outer Space
videos.overview: Courage tries to stop an alien chicken's plans to invade Earth while in his owners' farm.

videos.title: Pizza Boy: No Tip
videos.overview: Pizza Boy must deliver a pizza from his dad Kocoum to Antarctica safe and sound under five minutes, or else he will receive no tip.

videos.title: Gramps
videos.overview: Gramps tells his grandchildren about his battle against invading aliens.

videos.title: Dexter's Laboratory: The Big Sister
videos.overview: Dexter prevents giantess Dee Dee from attacking the whole city.

videos.title: Bloo's Gang: Bow-Wow Buccaneers
videos.overview: Bloo and his dog friends sneak out of their owner's houses at midnight to set on a pirate adventure in the city.

videos.title: Jungle Boy: Mr. Monkeyman
videos.overview: Jealous King Raymond attempts to taint hero Jungle Boy's reputation after he begins to lose fame.

videos.title: Godfrey & Zeek: Lost Control
videos.overview: A giraffe (Godfrey) and a pig (Zeek) leave their zoo home and visit a residual water treatment plant to retrieve the remote control they accidentally flushed down the toilet.

videos.title: Tumbleweed Tex: School Daze
videos.overview: A Wild West outlaw needs to finish the fourth grade and deal with his obnoxious class rival, Little Timmy.

videos.title: Buy One, Get One Free
videos.overview: A man named Reilly gets a cat named Flinch to impress a female cat lover named Sofie and threatens the cat that if there is a scratch on anything while he's away, he will send him to the violin factory. It won't be easy when Sophie leaves Flinch a feline playmate named Fix that only wants to party.

videos.title: The Kitchen Casanova
videos.overview: A first-time cook is preparing a dinner for his date. Trouble arises when the wind flips the pages from his cookbook.

videos.title: The Ignoramooses
videos.overview: Two moose believe they are going to be adopted by a rich hunter due to tracking collars that a biologist put on them (they think they are pet collars), and wreak havoc in his mansion.

videos.title: Johnny Bravo: Johnny Bravo and the Amazon Women
videos.overview: Johnny Bravo is left stranded in an island filled with beautiful giant women.

videos.title: Pfish and Chip: Blammo the Clown
videos.overview: The bomb squad, Pfish and Chip, face yet another clown bomber, Blammo. It isn't easy when they have to watch and protect the chief's teddy bear whilst trying to stop the clown.

videos.title: Awfully Lucky
videos.overview: A greedy guy named Luther discovers the Paradox Pearl, which brings him good luck, but not without consequences. When Luther tries to turn it in to the city museum for ten million dollars, he finds out just how harsh the consequences are.

videos.title: Strange Things
videos.overview: A robot finds a job as a janitor. He must remember that if it says "Don't Touch", don't touch.

videos.title: Snoot's New Squat
videos.overview: Snoot, the flea-like alien, finds a new home on a neurotic neat-freak dog, Al.

videos.title: Larry and Steve
videos.overview: Steve, a homeless dog, is adopted by dimwit Larry (the only man to understand dog) and lives disaster after disaster when Larry takes him shopping.

videos.title: Sledgehammer O'Possum: What's Goin' on Back There!?
videos.overview: Sledgehammer O'Possum takes shelter from the cold in a mailbox, much to the dismay of a mailman named Ethel who will stop at nothing to make him leave.

videos.title: The Zoonatiks: Home Sweet Home
videos.overview: A bear named Bill, a monkey named Knuckles and a turtle named Shelby try to enter the all-star Hackensack Zoo after feeling unwanted at the circus.

videos.title: Swamp and Tad: Mission Imfrogable
videos.overview: Swamp and Tad, two frog guards who work on Planet Marsh, are sent by the King to get a package on Earth.

videos.title: Dino: The Great Egg-Scape
videos.overview: Dino takes care of a baby dinosaur and tries to prevent him from growing.

videos.title: Malcom and Melvin
videos.overview: Melvin is an alienated loser until he meets Malcom, a trumpeter cockroach who has a huge talent.

videos.title: Tales of Worm Paranoia
videos.overview: Johnny is a peaceful and forgiving worm until a human steps on him repeatedly. As a result, the worm becomes paranoid and angered at the human race, seeking revenge.

videos.title: Malcom and Melvin: Babe! He... Calls Me
videos.overview: Melvin's saga continues as his partnership with Malcom is compromised by an urban superhero's intrusion. Meanwhile, Melvin's mother aids a criminal after being unable to meet with her son.

videos.title: Kenny and the Chimp: Diseasy Does It! or Chimp 'n' Pox
videos.overview: A boy named Kenny, and his pet chimpanzee, Chimpy, must watch Professor XXXL's disease laboratory while he's away. However, Chimpy causes trouble for Kenny.

videos.title: Mike, Lu & Og: Crash Lancelot
videos.overview: A cast away girl named Mike asks for native inventor Og to build a car to get across the island. He also builds a specially improved model for princess Lu, which runs too fast for her.

videos.title: King Crab: Space Crustacean
videos.overview: The youngest crew member of King Crab's intergalactic space cruiser has his body invaded by a life-sucking outer space parasite.

videos.title: The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy: Meet the Reaper
videos.overview: Billy and Mandy are paid a visit by the Grim Reaper when he comes to collect the soul of Billy's hamster, Mr. Snuggles. Mandy then makes a bet with him in the form of a game: if Grim loses, he lets them keep Mr. Snuggles AND become their "best friend".

videos.title: Whatever Happened to Robot Jones?
videos.overview: Robot Jones learns that he has been put into a human public school that he must now attend.

videos.title: Trevor!: Journey to Sector 5-G
videos.overview: This cartoon follows the wild world of Trevor Braithwaite whose doodles dance right off the page.

videos.title: Nikki
videos.overview: Two friends find unusual responses to their on-line postings after they try to cheer up a broken-hearted woman in the park.

videos.title: Foe Paws
videos.overview: This cartoon follows the misadventures of an eccentric old woman who tries to replace her long lost children by dressing up her cat and dog in human clothes.

videos.title: Prickles the Cactus
videos.overview: Its plot follows the mishaps of a clumsy water-phobic cactus who helps save her family from a deadly drought at Cyclone Ranch.

videos.title: Lucky Lydia: Club Lydia
videos.overview: This cartoon follows the unwittingly lucky Lydia Lucas, who is raised by half-crazy parents and narrowly misses her demise at the hands of the Baxter Boys again and again.

videos.title: Longhair and Doubledome: Good Wheel Hunting
videos.overview: This cartoon follows two philosophical cavemen who just don't fit into their prehistoric surroundings.

videos.title: Lost Cat
videos.overview: A homeless purple cat attempts to scam his way into cozy new digs by passing himself off as someone else's lost cat.

videos.title: Uncle Gus: For the Love of Monkeys
videos.overview: This cartoon follows the journey of a wily unemployed geezer and his rag-tailed bunch of friends as they travel to the zoo to reunite Uncle Gus with his AWOL fiancée.

videos.title: Sheep in the Big City: In the Baa-ginning
videos.overview: Sheep leaves Farmer John's farm in pursuit of a happy life in the city.

videos.title: Thrillseekers: Putt 'n' Perish
videos.overview: A group of thrill seekers, Ashley, Joe and Otto, attempt to conquer the world's most dangerous golf course, "Putt & Perish".

videos.title: Captain Sturdy: Back in Action!
videos.overview: The long-retired Captain Sturdy must return to action when the Union of Super Heroes cancels his pension. Upon returning to duty, he discovers that the organization has lost sight of what it means to be a superhero and has become more concerned with political correctness and marketing deals than saving the world from the evil Moid's clutches.

videos.title: Yee Hah & Doo Dah: Bronco Breakin' Boots
videos.overview: A cowboy and his horse, Yee Hah and Doo Dah, reside in Manhattan's Central Park. Yee Hah enjoys the city life until he discovers that the city pavement is giving him a dreadful blister. Much to Doo Dah's dismay, he decides to stop walking and ride his horse everywhere, thereby cramping Doo Dah's power-lunching lifestyle. Eventually, Doo Dah finds the real culprit behind Yee Hah's sore feet: the branding iron, tractor, etc. that Yee Hah has been hiding in his boots.

videos.title: IMP, Inc.
videos.overview: Travelling in an orbiting meteor, three Imps are up for review and are offered the opportunity to help a poor farm couple by granting them their wish for desperately needed rain to help their crops. They manage to deliver rain, but their hopes for promotion come crashing down when their meteor smashes the couple's crops.

videos.title: My Freaky Family: Welcome to My World
videos.overview: It's Nadine's first day of school, a significant historical event considered by her mother to be one of many "milestone days", which must be documented with a photo. She manages to make it onto the school bus without being photographed, but her "freaky" family grabs the camera and jumps on the family multi-seater bicycle for a mortifying chase to catch up with her.

videos.title: Major Flake: Soggy Sale
videos.overview: Major Flake, a frenetic French cereal mascot, and his grim sidekick, Sparkles must find a way to sell their rather unappealing Major Flake cereal before their boss, Sylvia Soggy, pulls the breakfast treat from store shelves.

videos.title: Utica Cartoon: Hotdog Champeen
videos.overview: When Dan Bear and Micah Monkey learn that they can get free hot dogs by beating the current hot dog eating record at their local diner, they are up for the challenge. Dan Bear reigns as hot dog champ by consuming loads of free hot dogs, continually beating his own record. For awhile he enjoys the free franks until beating the record becomes too much even for him.

videos.title: Codename: Kids Next Door — No P in the OOL
videos.overview: When the villainous Mr. Wink and Mr. Fibb extend the adult swimtime to extreme lengths at the neighborhood pool, the Kids Next Door plan to strike back with vengeance.

videos.title: Swaroop: Bovine Bliss
videos.overview: Swaroop and his family are trying to assimilate their Indian heritage with modern American culture. The differences become glaringly apparent when their neighbor brings home a cow to throw on the barbecue. Swaroop decides to hide the sacred cow before the neighbors can cook it for dinner.

videos.title: Ferret and Parrot
videos.overview: A ferret and parrot fight for the affection of a comic strip character. Meanwhile, their owner tries to get rid of ants that have infested the house.

videos.title: Uncle Gus: Not So Fast!
videos.overview: In the second Uncle Gus short, Gus enters his loyal horse, Flapjack, in a horse race to win a bet with mysterious paperboy Ali Ali.

videos.title: A Kitty Bobo Show: Cellphones
videos.overview: Kitty Bobo wants to prove that he's cool by getting a cell phone. Unfortunately, he doesn't seem to be receiving many important calls, thereby reducing his cool factor, so he begins to fake incoming calls. It's only a matter of time before everyone catches on to the farce.

videos.title: Commander Cork: Space Ranger
videos.overview: Commander Cork is an enthusiastic and overzealous, though not very bright, do-gooder. When he meets Peggy and Petey Paddle, a brother and sister duo who share a fascination with outer space, he decides to bring them with him on his wacky space adventures.

videos.title: LowBrow: Test Drive
videos.overview: During a routine trip to the garbage dump, suburban misfit Coop discovers an advanced robot from the future. Coop brings the treasure home and retools it to suit his modern-day slacker needs.

videos.title: Longhair and Doubledome: Where There's Smoke... There's Bob!
videos.overview: In their second animated cartoon outing, Longhair and Doubledome discover fire. Having never before seen fire, Doubledome concludes that the blaze must be his son, Bob.

videos.title: Jeffrey Cat: Claw and Order — All Dogs Don't Go to Heaven
videos.overview: Jeffrey Cat has never met a crime he couldn't lick. A surge in the pet population raises the need for a pet investigator. Jeffrey Cat, the sergeant on all pet-related cases, makes it his mission to safeguard the rights of all of the pets in the community. When a friendly dog is accused of attacking a neighbor, Jeffrey Cat smells a rat.

videos.title: Fungus Among Us
videos.overview: Keeping clean is a dirty business, as the animated mascots from cleaning product commercials well know. Fungus Among Us follows the trials and tribulations of the fungus who must coexist with the cleaning agents that have been created to destroy them.

videos.title: Colin Versus the World: Mr. Lounge Lizard
videos.overview: Colin is a color-blind chameleon whose life is full of mishaps and blunders. While working as a shelf stocker at Cheapway's Supermarket, Colin passes the days with dreams of becoming a Lounge Lizard in Las Vegas.

videos.title: Maktar
videos.overview: Slashing through our gassy universe, hurtling through our own Milky Way, an invader from the far reaches of Space comes knocking upon our atmospheric door. Sent by Zen and his Space Council, Maktar's mission is to conquer Earth. But, Maktar, a sniveling middle manager and galactic pushover, couldn't invade someone's privacy let alone conquer our Great Blue Planet.

videos.title: Bagboy!
videos.overview: Parker is a typical 14-year-old with the usual adolescent trials, except when he is a Bagboy. Carefully selected by the elite intergalactic council, known as the Bagi, Parker moonlights as a powerful superhero.
